description: NEWAVE is CEPEL’s long-term hydrothermal and renewable-energy operation model. It applies stochastic dual dynamic programming to produce operating policies and future-cost functions, which feed shorter-term models including DECOMP. The provider is Centro de Pesquisas de Energia Elétrica (CEPEL). Coverage: The documented operational context is Brazil’s interconnected electricity system. The provider describes planning up to ten years ahead; study boundaries and input scenarios are supplied for each run. Access: The provider’s energy-optimisation documentation was read. Software distribution, input decks and operational licences were not obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: An operating policy is conditional on model assumptions and inflow, wind, demand and system data. Access rights and solver/version compatibility remain unverified. For simulation it supports long-term operating-policy, water-value and uncertainty analysis. Related resources: DECOMP and DESSEM are distinct shorter-term models in the same chain; this record is limited to NEWAVE.
